protocol.purpose: Research assistance for manual review of English news, not autonomous truth adjudication.
protocol.primary_kpi: Macro-F1 with bootstrap interval on independent raw headlines; report full-text ISOT separately.

partitions.train: Original chronological train, excluding evaluation labels.
partitions.tuning: First 40 percent of original validation dates/rows.
partitions.internal_reused_test: Old test already observed in v1; diagnostic, not a new confirmatory test.
partitions.external: Pinned FakeNewsNet raw CSV titles, evaluated only after candidate and policy are frozen.

protocol.feature_rule: Remove predeclared publisher/contact/byline/social boilerplate. ANOVA and SHAP are diagnostics, never independent validation or a rule that high importance is bad.
protocol.calibration: Member Platt calibrators and fusion Platt calibrator fit on separate chronological subsets.
protocol.external_unit: Headline only. No tweet hydration or publisher scraping. Compare with ISOT headline-only diagnostic.
protocol.external_reuse_rule: Never tune on external labels. A failed release gate remains failed; future tuning requires a new independent external set.

negative_controls.selection_fit: ANOVA selector refitted for every shuffled training-label vector.

protocol.legal_scope_assumption: Local noncommercial academic research in Moldova; no redistribution/public deployment clearance asserted.

preflight: Only availability/schema inspected before registration, not external model performance.
